1283-1651-2557-4365-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Parallel Lives and Mondrak.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-2557-4365-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1409-1874-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-4247-6972--112.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
1579-4247-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2438-2738-4871-6255.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-3129-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-3129-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

821-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Mogg Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1999-3263-7340-7434.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-3263-7340-7434.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Brass Infiniscope from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Brass Infiniscope from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
1999-3263-7340-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

2021-2060-6260-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-5434-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5434-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2292-3276-5038-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat as needed.

2438-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
2438-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2438-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

967-3809-4365-5686-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

618-2511-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

539-1315-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5696-5702-6791.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5696-5702-6791.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1189-2302-4957.notablePrerequisites: Any color chosen with Painter's Servant.
1189-2302-4957.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Spreading Plague triggers, destroying all creatures, as they all share a color due to Painter's Servant.
Because Eldrazi Monument gives your creatures indestructible, only your opponents' creatures are destroyed.

609-1185-1816-3525-4898.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig and Mine Worker do not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mine Worker.
609-1185-1816-3525-4898.description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.

377-2427-2640-2672-4050.notablePrerequisites: Nyxborn Shieldmate attached to Mogis's Warhound.
377-2427-2640-2672-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mogis's Warhound, adding {R}.
Mogis's Warhound leaves the battlefield, causing Nyxborn Shieldmate to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Mogis's Warhound from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mogis's Warhound for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Nyxborn Shieldmate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Shieldmate, adding {W}.
Nyxborn Shieldmate leaves the battlefield, causing Mogis's Warhound to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Shieldmate from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Shieldmate for its bestow cost by paying {W}, attaching it to Mogis's Warhound.
Repeat.

579-1562-5137.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1563-2850-3192-5223.notablePrerequisites: At least two +1/+1 counters on Ulasht.
1563-2850-3192-5223.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ulasht, creating a 1/1 Saporling creature token.
The Saproling token enters triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Activate the Saproling token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-3696.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-3696.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Bone Saw to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Bone Saw.
Cast Bone Saw.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

950-3078-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3078-4222.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
